procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial review of only the expressly pinned inputs. Packet and case were read, rule/rubric/addendum/method and adapter were read, and all five pinned native-evidence manifests were read before poster viewing. The packet declares no source assets or protected-layout manifests, so both corresponding receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Each exact poster file was displayed through tools.view_image with detail original and its returned image was inspected: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M2 in that order; M3 in that order; M4 in that order; and M5 in that order. All fifteen actual poster displays completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, image judgment, rating or set judgment. First reads below were subsequently taken from the already displayed native images, with readability and composition assessed against the already displayed usage720 and thumbnail320 images. No copy ambiguity required a revisit. Hash/byte checks and PNG header checks establish bindings and dimensions only; the successful viewing attestations here refer to the actual returned image displays. No session identity is claimed.
